answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use a probation ramp: every new identity starts on a frozen tundra of zero influence and earns weight only through months of consistent, verified useful work. Influence grows slowly like a dune shaped by wind, and any proven sockpuppetry drops the account off a ledge back to zero. Time cannot be bought in bulk, so an attacker must tend each fake identity for months before it matters, making large sybil swarms economically pointless.
